// dispatch: rewind min-savings floor (#21)
//
// Scenario pins from the issue-#20 repro, hermetic:
//   A — anchor→immediate rewind (zero/negligible work above the anchor)
//       must be REJECTED by the min-savings floor, never summarized;
//   B — healthy stages (≥20k apparent savings) must still request the
//       summary. (The immediate re-rewind of a just-landed summary is
//       pinned in the phase-2 block.)
// =============================================================================

describe("dispatch: rewind min-savings floor (#21)", () => {
  /** No newLabel may survive a rejected rewind — the label isn't consumed. */
  function assertLabelAbsent(sm: SessionManager, label: string): void {
    for (const e of sm.getBranch()) {
      assert.notEqual(sm.getLabel(e.id), label);
    }
  }

  it("A-pin variant A: anchor→immediate rewind with an earlier anchor present is rejected with the active-anchor list", async () => {
    const { sm, pi, tool, ctx } = setup();
    const t1 = appendTurn(sm, "u1", "a1", 6_000);
    pi.pi.setLabel(t1.assistantId, "anchor:kickoff");
    const t2 = appendTurn(sm, "u2", "a2", 12_000);
    pi.pi.setLabel(t2.assistantId, "anchor:impl-start");

    // setLabel advances the leaf (label-change entry), so the leaf here is
    // the impl-start label entry — exactly the issue-#20 repro shape:
    // anchor, then immediately rewind with zero work above.
    const branchBefore = sm.getBranch().map((e) => e.id);
    const leafBefore = sm.getLeafId();

    const r = await tool.execute(
      "tc-floor-a",
      {
        action: "rewind",
        rewindTo: "impl-start",
        newLabel: "done",
        summaryFocus: "Preserve user instructions and continue.",
      },
      undefined,
      undefined,
      ctx,
    );

    assert.equal(r.isError, true);
    assert.equal(r.details.rejected, "min-savings");
    assert.ok(typeof r.details.apparentSavings === "number");
    const text = r.content[0].text;
    assert.match(text, /would free only/);
    // Movement-order copy (#43): rewind TO the anchor, collapsed AS the new
    // label. An arrow reading `'impl-start' → 'done'` inverts the operation.
    assert.match(text, /Rewinding to 'impl-start' \(as 'done'\)/);
    // Variant A guidance + the full chronological anchor list, including
    // rewindTo itself.
    assert.match(text, /Rewind further back to actually free context/);
    assert.match(text, / {2}kickoff\n/);
    assert.match(text, / {2}impl-start$/);
    // Byte-exact pin (#84 moved the anchor walk into formatActiveAnchors).
    assert.equal(
      text,
      "Rewinding to 'impl-start' (as 'done') would free only ~0.0k tokens. Rewind further back to actually free context, or keep working.\nActive anchors (root → leaf, % of 1.0M):\n   0.6%  kickoff\n   1.2%  impl-start",
    );
    // The numeric bar itself is NEVER printed agent-visible.
    assert.ok(
      !text.includes(String(MIN_REWIND_SAVINGS_TOKENS)),
      "rejection copy must not print the floor value",
    );
    // Nothing pending; newLabel not consumed; tree untouched.
    assert.equal(fireToolCall(pi, ctx), undefined);
    assertLabelAbsent(sm, "anchor:done");
    assert.deepEqual(
      sm.getBranch().map((e) => e.id),
      branchBefore,
    );
    assert.equal(sm.getLeafId(), leafBefore);
  });

  it("A-pin variant B: rewinding the OLDEST anchor is rejected with 'No earlier anchors'", async () => {
    const { sm, pi, tool, ctx } = setup();
    const t1 = appendTurn(sm, "u1", "a1", 6_000);
    pi.pi.setLabel(t1.assistantId, "anchor:start");
    // One tiny turn above the anchor: measured savings ≈ 1 token.
    appendTurn(sm, "u2", "a2", 6_001);

    const r = await tool.execute(
      "tc-floor-b",
      {
        action: "rewind",
        rewindTo: "start",
        newLabel: "done",
        summaryFocus: "Preserve user instructions and continue.",
      },
      undefined,
      undefined,
      ctx,
    );

    assert.equal(r.isError, true);
    assert.equal(r.details.rejected, "min-savings");
    const text = r.content[0].text;
    assert.match(text, /would free only/);
    assert.match(
      text,
      /No earlier anchors — keep working and rewind later once more has accumulated above it\./,
    );
    assert.match(text, /'start'/);
    assert.equal(
      text,
      "Rewinding to 'start' (as 'done') would free only ~0.0k tokens. No earlier anchors — keep working and rewind later once more has accumulated above it.\nActive anchors (root → leaf, % of 1.0M):\n   0.6%  start",
    );
    assert.ok(!text.includes(String(MIN_REWIND_SAVINGS_TOKENS)));
    assert.equal(fireToolCall(pi, ctx), undefined);
    assertLabelAbsent(sm, "anchor:done");
  });

  it("A-pin variant B at contextWindow 0: k-format percents, no window suffix", async () => {
    const { sm, pi, tool, ctx } = setup({ contextWindow: 0 });
    const t1 = appendTurn(sm, "u1", "a1", 6_000);
    pi.pi.setLabel(t1.assistantId, "anchor:start");
    appendTurn(sm, "u2", "a2", 6_001);
    const r = await tool.execute(
      "tc-floor-b0",
      {
        action: "rewind",
        rewindTo: "start",
        newLabel: "done",
        summaryFocus: "Preserve user instructions and continue.",
      },
      undefined,
      undefined,
      ctx,
    );
    assert.equal(r.details.rejected, "min-savings");
    assert.equal(
      r.content[0].text,
      "Rewinding to 'start' (as 'done') would free only ~0.0k tokens. No earlier anchors — keep working and rewind later once more has accumulated above it.\nActive anchors (root → leaf):\n   6.0k  start",
    );
  });

  it("an empty-named manual label never counts as the oldest anchor", async () => {
    const { sm, pi, tool, ctx } = setup();
    const t0 = appendTurn(sm, "u0", "a0", 3_000);
    pi.pi.setLabel(t0.assistantId, "anchor:");
    const t1 = appendTurn(sm, "u1", "a1", 6_000);
    pi.pi.setLabel(t1.assistantId, "anchor:start");
    appendTurn(sm, "u2", "a2", 6_001);
    const r = await tool.execute(
      "tc-floor-empty",
      {
        action: "rewind",
        rewindTo: "start",
        newLabel: "done",
        summaryFocus: "Preserve user instructions and continue.",
      },
      undefined,
      undefined,
      ctx,
    );
    assert.equal(r.details.rejected, "min-savings");
    assert.match(
      r.content[0].text,
      /No earlier anchors — keep working and rewind later once more has accumulated above it\./,
    );
    // The rejection lists only names rewindTo accepts (no `''`).
    assert.match(
      r.content[0].text,
      /\nActive anchors \(root → leaf, % of 1\.0M\):\n +[\d.]+% {2}start$/,
    );
  });

  it("B-pin: healthy stage (≥20k apparent savings) requests the summary", async () => {
    const { sm, pi, tool, ctx } = setup();
    const t1 = appendTurn(sm, "u1", "a1", 6_000);
    pi.pi.setLabel(t1.assistantId, "anchor:start");
    appendTurn(sm, "u2", "a2", 27_000);
    appendTurn(sm, "u3", "a3", 28_000);

    const r = await tool.execute(
      "tc-floor-bpin",
      {
        action: "rewind",
        rewindTo: "start",
        newLabel: "end",
        summaryFocus: "Preserve user instructions and continue.",
      },
      undefined,
      undefined,
      ctx,
    );

    assert.equal(r.isError, undefined);
    assert.equal(r.details.status, "summary-requested");
    // Apparent savings = contextBefore − anchor-time total (6_000).
    const before = r.details.contextBefore as number;
    assert.ok(
      before - 6_000 >= 20_000,
      `expected ≥20k apparent savings; got ${before - 6_000}`,
    );
    assert.ok(fireToolCall(pi, ctx), "the rewind is pending");
  });

  it("boundary: apparent savings just under the floor rejects; exactly at the floor accepts", async () => {
    // Deterministic measurement math: with 'u*'/'a*' texts (2 chars → 1
    // estimated trailing token each), a chain anchored at a1(T1) with leaf
    // a3(T3) measures beforeTokens = T2 + 1 and tokensAtTarget = T1, i.e.
    //   apparentSavings = T2 + 1 − T1.
    async function floorFixture(t2Total: number) {
      const { sm, pi, tool, ctx } = setup();
      const t1 = appendTurn(sm, "u1", "a1", 5_000);
      pi.pi.setLabel(t1.assistantId, "anchor:start");
      appendTurn(sm, "u2", "a2", t2Total);
      appendTurn(sm, "u3", "a3", t2Total + 1_000);
      return { pi, tool, ctx };
    }
    const rewindArgs = {
      action: "rewind",
      rewindTo: "start",
      newLabel: "end",
      summaryFocus: "Preserve user instructions and continue.",
    } as const;

    // Just UNDER: T2 = 5000 + MIN − 999 → savings = MIN − 998.
    const under = await floorFixture(5_000 + MIN_REWIND_SAVINGS_TOKENS - 999);
    const ru = await under.tool.execute(
      "tc-under",
      rewindArgs,
      undefined,
      undefined,
      under.ctx,
    );
    assert.equal(ru.isError, true);
    assert.equal(ru.details.rejected, "min-savings");
    assert.ok(
      (ru.details.apparentSavings as number) < MIN_REWIND_SAVINGS_TOKENS,
    );
    assert.equal(fireToolCall(under.pi, under.ctx), undefined);

    // AT the floor: T2 = 5000 + MIN − 1 → savings = MIN exactly (the guard
    // is strict `<`, so this accepts).
    const at = await floorFixture(5_000 + MIN_REWIND_SAVINGS_TOKENS - 1);
    const ra = await at.tool.execute(
      "tc-at",
      rewindArgs,
      undefined,
      undefined,
      at.ctx,
    );
    assert.equal(ra.isError, undefined);
    // Success details carry contextBefore (= T2 + 1); savings = that minus
    // the anchor-time total (5_000).
    const before = ra.details.contextBefore as number;
    assert.equal(
      before - 5_000,
      MIN_REWIND_SAVINGS_TOKENS,
      "savings exactly at the floor must be accepted (strict < comparison)",
    );
    assert.ok(fireToolCall(at.pi, at.ctx), "the accepted rewind is pending");
  });

  it("anchor response tells the agent to wait for accumulated work (#21 copy)", async () => {
    const { sm, tool, ctx } = setup();
    appendTurn(sm, "u1", "a1", 100);

    const r = await tool.execute(
      "tc-anchor-copy",
      { action: "anchor", name: "impl-start" },
      undefined,
      undefined,
      ctx,
    );
    assert.equal(r.isError, undefined);
    const text = r.content[0].text;
    assert.ok(
      text.includes("Once real work has accumulated after this anchor"),
      `anchor copy must steer toward accumulating work; got: ${text}`,
    );
    assert.ok(
      !text.includes("When you finish this stage"),
      "pre-#21 anchor copy must be gone",
    );
    // The focus-length constant stays interpolated (no hardcoded 20).
    assert.ok(text.includes(`≥${MIN_SUMMARY_FOCUS_LENGTH}-char focus`));
  });

  it("registers the rewind-hygiene and pin promptGuidelines byte-exactly and in order", () => {
    // Exact array length + per-element byte equality + order (the 2026-09-13
    // reflection's Lesson 3: `includes`-only pins pass under reordering).
    // These bullets are static and NOT config-gated — `registerTool` fixes
    // the array at registration, so every active-tool session carries them
    // (and pays the one-time prompt-cache prefix invalidation on upgrade).
    const { tool } = setup();
    const guidelines = tool.promptGuidelines as string[] | undefined;
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(guidelines), "promptGuidelines must be registered");
    const expected = [
      "navigate_tree: when rewinding, prefer the oldest anchor that keeps what you'd otherwise re-read or re-derive; persist durable findings to files first.",
      "navigate_tree: don't rewind while a user decision or unresolved question is pending — ask the user instead.",
      "navigate_tree: pin durable sub-goals, decisions, facts and file pointers you must not lose across folds; the user's own rules and goals are captured automatically and cannot be pinned or changed by you.",
    ];
    assert.equal(
      guidelines?.length,
      expected.length,
      `promptGuidelines must carry exactly ${expected.length} bullets; got: ${guidelines?.length}`,
    );
    assert.deepEqual(guidelines, expected);
    for (let i = 0; i < expected.length; i++) {
      assert.equal(
        guidelines?.[i],
        expected[i],
        `guidelines[${i}] must be byte-exact; got: ${guidelines?.[i]}`,
      );
    }
  });
});

  async function providerPayload(
    f: Forced,
    payload: unknown,
  ): Promise<unknown> {

const sessionInstances: WeakRef<AgentSession>[] = [];
let seenSessions = new WeakSet<AgentSession>();

function captureSession(session: AgentSession): void {
  if (seenSessions.has(session)) return;
  seenSessions.add(session);
  sessionInstances.push(new WeakRef(session));
  // Reap dead WeakRefs occasionally so the array doesn't grow unbounded
  // across /new and /resume cycles.
  if (sessionInstances.length > MAX_SESSION_REFS) {
    for (let i = sessionInstances.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (!sessionInstances[i].deref()) sessionInstances.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}

function patchAgentSessionPrototype(): void {
  const proto = AgentSession.prototype as unknown as Record<
    PropertyKey,
    unknown
  >;
  // Stash the truly-original prompt the FIRST time we patch. On subsequent
  // /reloads the value is already there — we don't overwrite, we just read it
  // back so the new wrapper still calls the original (not a previous wrapper).
  if (!proto[ORIG_PROMPT_KEY]) {
    proto[ORIG_PROMPT_KEY] = proto.prompt;
  }
  const orig = proto[ORIG_PROMPT_KEY] as (...args: unknown[]) => unknown;

  // Always replace the wrapper, even if a previous load already patched. On
  // /reload the previous wrapper closes over the previous module's
  // `sessionInstances` — if we don't replace, captures land in the dead
  // module and reflection finds nothing.
  const patched = function (this: AgentSession, ...args: unknown[]) {
    captureSession(this);
    return orig.apply(this, args);
  };
  proto.prompt = patched;
}

    if (s && asInternals(s).sessionManager === sm) {

 * `buildContextEntries()` view would reintroduce edited-away messages into the
 * request (and desync the summary payload's `{first}` numbering from what the
 * model actually sees). The entry walk remains only as a defensive fallback
 * for structural test doubles.

 * conversation messages without prompt and tool system messages; Pi restores
 * that state afterward" (pi docs, `context` section), and `runner.emitContext`
 * hands handlers `currentMessages.filter(role !== "system")` and re-attaches
 * the current head via `restoreSystemMessages`. Returning the projection's
 * system entries would make that re-attach prepend the head to a list still
 * carrying the persisted system entry — a duplicated head on runs where
 * `forceSystemPrompt` is unset.
 *
 * We always replace (no leaf-gating): every `appendMessage` advances the
 * session leaf, so a "leaf changed since last turn" heuristic would fire on
 * essentially every call anyway — and always-replace is byte-for-byte the
 * behavior of the old wrapper (per-turn rebuild from the tree).
 *
 * The parameter is typed structurally because `ReadonlySessionManager` is
 * NOT re-exported from the package barrel (only `SessionManager` and
 * `sessionEntryToContextMessages` are public); `ctx.sessionManager` at the
 * event site is `ReadonlySessionManager`.
 */
export function buildContextMessages(
  sm: {
    buildContextEntries(): SessionEntry[];
    buildSessionProjection?(): {
      entries?: Array<{ sourceEntry: SessionEntry; messages: AgentMessage[] }>;
      messages: AgentMessage[];
      model?: { provider: string; modelId: string } | null;
    };
    getBranch?(): SessionEntry[];
    getLabel?(id: string): string | undefined;
  },
  pendingInstructionEntryId?: string | null,
): ReturnType<typeof sessionEntryToContextMessages> {
  let entries:
    | Array<{ sourceEntry: SessionEntry | null; messages: AgentMessage[] }>
    | undefined;
  let model: { provider: string; modelId: string } | null | undefined;
  try {
    if (typeof sm.buildSessionProjection === "function") {
      const projection = sm.buildSessionProjection();
      model = projection.model;
      entries = Array.isArray(projection.entries)
        ? projection.entries
        : [{ sourceEntry: null, messages: projection.messages }];
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall through to the raw entry projection — pi rewrites the context
    // handlers' output at the wire boundary anyway.
  }
  entries ??= sm.buildContextEntries().map((entry) => ({
    sourceEntry: entry,
    messages: sessionEntryToContextMessages(entry),
  }));
  // Withholding can append edits after the frozen summary instruction.
  entries = invalidateStaleUsage(entries, model);
  // Frozen view (#90, O2): while a rewind waits for its summary, the
  // request ends at its instruction, so every attempt re-sends the same
  // messages — late input and hidden attempts never reach it. Keyed by the
  // instruction's entry id: tool-call ids can be "" or reused.
  if (pendingInstructionEntryId) {
    const at = entries.findIndex(
      (e) => e.sourceEntry?.id === pendingInstructionEntryId,
    );
    if (at >= 0) {
      entries = entries.slice(0, at + 1);
    }
  }
  // A failed / aborted rewind reads as a failed tool call (#90, O5): its
  // tool result's content is already replaced by a persisted `context_edit`,
  // but `isError` is not editable — set it on a clone, per request (never
  // mutate the session's own message objects). Keyed by the tool-result
  // entry id the outcome recorded.
  const outcomes = collectRewindOutcomes(sm);
  const messages = entries.flatMap((e) => {
    const text = e.sourceEntry ? outcomes.get(e.sourceEntry.id) : undefined;
    const withOutcome =
      text === undefined
        ? e.messages
        : e.messages.map((message) =>
            message.role === "toolResult"
              ? {
                  ...message,
                  content: [{ type: "text" as const, text }],
                  isError: true,
                }
              : message,
          );
    const legacyOwned =
      e.sourceEntry?.type === "branch_summary" &&
      e.sourceEntry.fromHook === true &&
      sm.getLabel?.(e.sourceEntry.id)?.startsWith(LABEL_PREFIX) === true;
    return handoffContext(e.sourceEntry, withOutcome, legacyOwned);
  });

/** True for the summary instruction entry of the rewind `toolCallId` (#90). */
function isSummaryRequestEntry(
  entry: SessionEntry,
  toolCallId: string,
): boolean {
  return (
    entry.type === "custom_message" &&
    entry.customType === SUMMARY_REQUEST_CUSTOM_TYPE &&
    (entry.details as { toolCallId?: unknown } | undefined)?.toolCallId ===
      toolCallId

}

/** Outcome entry `data` on `entry`, or null (#90). */
function readOutcomeData(entry: SessionEntry): RewindOutcomeData | null {
  if (
    entry.type !== "custom" ||
    entry.customType !== REWIND_OUTCOME_CUSTOM_TYPE
  ) {
    return null;
  }
  const data = entry.data as Partial<RewindOutcomeData> | undefined;
  if (
    !data ||
    typeof data.toolCallId !== "string" ||
    typeof data.text !== "string"
  ) {
    return null;
  }
  return data as RewindOutcomeData;
}

/**
 * Failed / aborted rewinds on the active branch: tool-result entry id →
 * result text.
 */
function collectRewindOutcomes(sm: {
  getBranch?(): SessionEntry[];
}): Map<string, string> {
  const out = new Map<string, string>();
  if (typeof sm.getBranch !== "function") return out;
  let branch: SessionEntry[];
  try {
    branch = sm.getBranch();
  } catch {
    return out;
  }
  for (const entry of branch) {
    const data = readOutcomeData(entry);
    if (data && typeof data.toolResultEntryId === "string") {
      out.set(data.toolResultEntryId, data.text);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

 * tool-call blocks (openai-completions: "Skip assistant messages that have no

 * messages and unknown block types pass (conservative: never under-count a
 * message the model might see).

function isProviderVisibleMessage(message: AgentMessage): boolean {
  if (message.role !== "assistant") return true;
  const content: unknown = message.content;
  if (typeof content === "string") return content.trim().length > 0;
  if (!Array.isArray(content)) return true;
  for (const block of content as unknown[]) {
    if (typeof block !== "object" || block === null) continue;
    const record = block as { [key: string]: unknown };
    const type = record.type;
    if (type === "text") {
      const text = record.text;

 * `isProviderVisibleMessage`) so an aborted, non-`context_edit`ed attempt

  projectedEntries: Array<{

    messages: AgentMessage[];

  target: string,
): number {

    for (const message of convertToLlm(entry.messages)) {

function refreshAgentMessages(sm: SessionManager): boolean {
  // Manually replicate the agent-state refresh that pi's
  // commandCtx.navigateTree does after branchWithSummary. Returns true on
  // success, false if reflection couldn't find the owning AgentSession (in
  // which case the rewind is structurally complete on disk, but the next LLM
  // call will still see stale messages).
  const session = findOwningSession(sm);
  if (!session) return false;
  try {
    const sessionContext = sm.buildSessionContext();
    const agent = asInternals(session).agent;
    if (!agent?.state) return false;
    agent.state.messages = sessionContext.messages;
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

async function emitSessionTree(
  sm: SessionManager,
  oldLeafId: string | null,
  summaryId: string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  // Replicate the `session_tree` emit that pi's own `navigateTree` does after
  // `branchWithSummary` (#79). A tool-driven rewind skips it, so extensions
  // that mirror the conversation never learn the history was rewritten:
  // pi-claude-bridge keeps resuming its Claude Code session with the full
  // pre-rewind context. Returns false when the runner is unreachable or a
  // handler throws; the rewind itself is already complete either way.

  const runner = session ? asInternals(session)._extensionRunner : undefined;

    await runner.emit({
      type: "session_tree",
      newLeafId: sm.getLeafId(),
      oldLeafId,
      summaryEntry: sm.getEntry(summaryId),
      fromExtension: true,

  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function findLabeledEntry(
  sm: SessionManager,
  fullLabel: string,
): string | null {
  const path = sm.getBranch();
  for (let i = path.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (sm.getLabel(path[i].id) === fullLabel) return path[i].id;

  return estimateContextTokens(sm.buildSessionContext().messages);

  entries: SessionEntry[],
  entryId: string,
  byId: Map<string, SessionEntry>,
): number {
  return estimateContextTokens(
    projectHandoffs(buildSessionProjection(entries, entryId, byId), entries)

  );

 * so rewinding to a pre-compaction anchor does not report negative savings.

  activeBranch: readonly SessionEntry[],
  entries: SessionEntry[],
  targetId: string,
  byId: Map<string, SessionEntry>,

    (e) => e.type === "compaction",

  if (compactionIdx < 0) return raw;
  const compaction = activeBranch[compactionIdx];

      buildSessionProjection(entries, compaction.id, byId),
      entries,

/** Explicit opt-in to remote analysis; tool rules apply to this proposal only. */
export interface ProposalArguments {
  readonly source?: string;
  readonly output?: string;

function words(raw: string): string[] {
  const result: string[] = [];
  let word = "";
  let quote: string | undefined;
  let started = false;
  for (let index = 0; index < raw.length; index++) {
    const character = raw[index];
    if (character === quote) {
      quote = undefined;
      continue;
    }
    if (!quote && (character === '"' || character === "'")) {
      quote = character;
      started = true;
      continue;
    }
    if (!quote && /\s/.test(character)) {
      if (started) result.push(word);
      word = "";
      started = false;
      continue;
    }
    if (
      character === "\\" &&
      quote !== "'" &&
      index + 1 < raw.length &&
      /[\s"'\\]/.test(raw[index + 1])
    )
      word += raw[++index];
    else word += character;
    started = true;
  }
  if (quote) throw new Error("Path quotes must match");
  if (started) result.push(word);
  return result;
}

/** Parse the same proposal flags for Pi commands and the offline CLI. */
export function parseProposalArguments(
  raw: string | readonly string[],
): ProposalArguments {
  const args = typeof raw === "string" ? words(raw) : [...raw];
  let source: string | undefined;
  let output: string | undefined;
  let model: string | undefined;
  let llm = false;
  let positional = false;
  const tools: Record<string, ProposalToolMode> = {};
  for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index++) {
    const arg = args[index];
    if (arg === "--" && !positional) {
      positional = true;
      continue;
    }
    if (!positional && arg === "--llm") {
      llm = true;
      continue;
    }
    if (!positional && arg.startsWith("--")) {
      const equal = arg.indexOf("=");
      const flag = equal < 0 ? arg : arg.slice(0, equal);
      const value = equal < 0 ? args[++index] : arg.slice(equal + 1);
      if (
        ![
          "--model",
          "--output",
          "--omit-tool",
          "--calls-only-tool",
          "--full-tool",
        ].includes(flag)
      )
        throw new Error(`Unknown proposal flag: ${flag}`);
      if (!value || value.startsWith("--"))
        throw new Error(`${flag} requires a value`);
      if (flag === "--model") {
        parseProposalModel(value);
        model = value;
        llm = true;
      } else if (flag === "--output") output = value;
      else
        Object.defineProperty(tools, value, {
          value:
            flag === "--omit-tool"
              ? "omit"
              : flag === "--calls-only-tool"
                ? "calls-only"
                : "full",
          enumerable: true,
          configurable: true,
        });
      continue;
    }
    if (source !== undefined || !arg)
      throw new Error(
        "Provide one session path; quote paths containing spaces",
      );
    source = arg;
  }
  return {
    source,
    output,
    llm,
    input: { ...(model === undefined ? {} : { model }), tools },
  };
}

/** Reject unsafe model ranges and fall back explicitly to local graph annotations. */
export function validateTreeProposal(
  snapshot: SessionSnapshot,
  proposal: TreeProposal,
): TreeProposal {
  try {
    const plan = parseRetrospectivePlan(proposal.plan);
    if (plan.source !== snapshot.path)
      throw new Error("Proposal source path changed");
    validateRetrospectivePlan(snapshot, plan);
    return { ...proposal, plan };
  } catch (error) {
    if (proposal.method === "heuristic") throw error;
    const warnings = [...proposal.warnings];
    const plan = parseRetrospectivePlan(
      buildHeuristicPlan(snapshot, (message) => warnings.push(message)),
    );
    validateRetrospectivePlan(snapshot, plan);
    warnings.push(
      `Model plan failed graph-safety validation; using the heuristic proposal: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`,
    );
    return { ...proposal, plan, method: "heuristic", warnings };
  }
}

function checkPlanAgainstSource(
  snapshot: SessionSnapshot,
  plan: RetrospectivePlan,
): RetrospectivePlan {
  if (plan.source !== snapshot.path || plan.sourceSha256 !== snapshot.sha256)
    throw new Error(
      "A proposal must retain the inspected source path and hash",
    );
  const parsed = parseRetrospectivePlan(plan);
  validateRetrospectivePlan(snapshot, parsed);
  return parsed;
}

/** Validate a proposal against its immutable source before saving a new private plan. */
export async function saveTreeProposal(
  snapshot: SessionSnapshot,
  plan: RetrospectivePlan,
  output?: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const parsed = checkPlanAgainstSource(snapshot, plan);
  if (sha256(await readFile(snapshot.path)) !== snapshot.sha256)
    throw new Error(
      "Source changed while deriving the tree; inspect and propose again. No plan was saved.",
    );
  const path =
    output ??
    join(dirname(snapshot.path), ".tree-clone-plans", `${randomUUID()}.json`);
  await mkdir(dirname(path), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  await writeFile(path, `${JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2)}\n`, {
    flag: "wx",
    mode: 0o600,
  });
  return path;
}

/** Format a compact chronological outline without including source transcript text. */
export function formatProposalOutline(plan: RetrospectivePlan): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  function visit(groups: RetrospectivePlan["groups"], depth: number) {
    for (const group of groups) {
      lines.push(
        `${"  ".repeat(depth)}[${group.state}] ${group.title ?? group.name} (${group.firstEntryId}..${group.lastEntryId})`.replace(
          /\p{Cc}/gu,
          " ",
        ),
      );
      visit(group.children, depth + 1);
    }
  }
  visit(plan.groups, 0);
  return lines.join("\n");
}

/** The outline screen: `s` (or Enter) saves, `e` edits the raw JSON plan, Escape cancels. Edits are validated before the outline shows them. */
async function reviewProposal(
  ctx: ExtensionCommandContext,
  snapshot: SessionSnapshot,
  proposal: TreeProposal,
): Promise<RetrospectivePlan | undefined> {
  let plan = proposal.plan;
  const index = entryIndex(snapshot.entries);
  const info: OutlineInfo = {
    sessionName: snapshot.name,
    entries: snapshot.entries.length,
    method: proposal.method,
    calls: proposal.calls,
    cost: proposal.usage.reduce((sum, usage) => sum + usage.cost.total, 0),
    warnings: proposal.warnings,
  };
  while (true) {
    const key = await showView(ctx, {
      breadcrumbs: ["Anchor", "Clone", "Propose"],
      rightBadge: outlineBadge(plan, info),
      enterAction: "save",
      cancelAction: "cancel",
      shortcuts: [
        { key: "e", action: "edit plan" },
        { key: "s", action: "save" },
      ],
      lines: (width) =>
        formatPlanOutline(plan, info, width, { entryIndex: index }),

    if (key !== "e") return plan;
    const edited = await ctx.ui.editor(
      "Review and save tree plan (original session stays untouched)",

async function modelProposal(
  snapshot: SessionSnapshot,
  input: ProposalOptions,
  ctx: ExtensionCommandContext,
  pi: ExtensionAPI,

  if (!ctx.hasUI)
    throw new Error(
      "Model proposals require UI confirmation here. Use the CLI propose --llm for an explicit noninteractive model request.",
    );
  if (!ctx.isIdle())
    throw new Error(
      "Wait until Pi is idle before requesting a model-assisted tree proposal",
    );
  const selected = resolveProposalModel({
    registry: ctx.modelRegistry,
    currentModel: ctx.model,
    currentThinking: pi.getThinkingLevel(),
    selector: input.model,
  });
  const runner = createProposalModelRunner({
    registry: ctx.modelRegistry,
    ...selected,
  });
  const rules =
    Object.entries(input.tools)
      .map(([name, mode]) => `${name}: ${mode}`)
      .join(", ") || "none (full tool calls and results)";
  const confirmed = await ctx.ui.confirm(
    `Analyze session with ${runner.name}?`,
    `Send the full textual history of "${snapshot.name}" across all branches to this model. Tool rules: ${rules}. Binary data is omitted. Large histories require multiple requests and incur provider charges. No session is changed; the resulting plan must be reviewed before cloning.`,
  );
  if (!confirmed) return undefined;
  type Result =
    | { kind: "ok"; proposal: TreeProposal }
    | { kind: "error"; error: unknown }
    | { kind: "cancelled" };
  const result = await ctx.ui.custom<Result>((tui, theme, _keys, done) => {
    const loader = new BorderedLoader(
      tui,
      theme,
      `Deriving session tree with ${runner.name}`,
    );
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (result: Result) => {
      if (!settled) {
        settled = true;
        done(result);
      }
    };
    loader.onAbort = () => finish({ kind: "cancelled" });
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const proposal = await proposeTree(snapshot, {
          input,
          model: runner,
          signal: loader.signal,
          onProgress: (message) => {
            if (!loader.signal.aborted)
              ctx.ui.setStatus("tree-proposal", message);
          },
        });
        if (loader.signal.aborted) finish({ kind: "cancelled" });
        else finish({ kind: "ok", proposal });
      } catch (error) {
        finish(
          loader.signal.aborted
            ? { kind: "cancelled" }

        loader.dispose();
        ctx.ui.setStatus("tree-proposal", undefined);

    runtime: readRuntimeConfig(ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId()),

  snapshot: SessionSnapshot,
): void {
  const positions = new Map(snapshot.entries.map((entry, i) => [entry.id, i]));
  const reservedNames = new Set(
    snapshot.entries.flatMap((entry) =>
      entry.type === "label" && entry.label
        ? [entry.label.replace(/^(anchor|branch):/, "")]
        : [],
    ),
  );
  const check = (
    groups: readonly RetrospectiveGroup[],
    low: number,
    high: number,
  ) => {
    let previous = low - 1;
    for (const group of groups) {
      if (reservedNames.has(group.name))
        throw new ProposalFailure(
          "Model group name collides with an existing label",
        );
      const first = positions.get(group.firstEntryId);
      const last = positions.get(group.lastEntryId);
      if (first === undefined || last === undefined)
        throw new ProposalFailure("Unknown model endpoint ID");
      if (first < low || last > high || first > last || first <= previous)
        throw new ProposalFailure("Invalid model range order or containment");
      if (group.mode !== undefined && group.mode !== plan.parentHandoffMode)
        throw new ProposalFailure("Model changed bound handoff mode");
      if (group.state === "folded" && last === snapshot.entries.length - 1)
        throw new ProposalFailure("Model folded current open tail");
      previous = last;
      check(group.children, first, last);
    }
  };
  check(plan.groups, 0, snapshot.entries.length - 1);
  const tail = snapshot.entries.at(-1)?.id;
  if (
    tail &&
    !plan.groups.some(
      (group) => group.lastEntryId === tail && group.state === "open",
    )
  )
    throw new ProposalFailure("Model omitted current open tail");
}

/** Refine local phases with bounded evidence extraction, or return an explicit local fallback. */
export async function proposeTree(
  snapshot: SessionSnapshot,
  options: {
    input?: ProposalOptions;
    model?: ProposalModelRunner;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
    onProgress?: (message: string) => void;
  } = {},
): Promise<TreeProposal> {
  options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
  validateCompleteToolCalls(snapshot);
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const plan = buildHeuristicPlan(snapshot, (message) =>
    warnings.push(message),
  );
  const { records, warnings: sourceWarnings } = buildProposalRecords(
    snapshot,
    options.input ?? { tools: {} },
  );
  warnings.push(...sourceWarnings);
  parseRetrospectivePlan(plan);
  const usage: Usage[] = [];
  let calls = 0;
  const fallback = (): TreeProposal => ({
    plan,
    method: "heuristic",
    warnings,
    calls,
    usage,
  });
  const runner = options.model;
  if (!runner) return fallback();
  try {
    // One UTF-8 byte per estimated token plus framing reserve deliberately overestimates text.
    const budget = Math.floor(
      runner.contextWindow - runner.maxOutputTokens - bytes(SYSTEM) - 512,
    );
    if (
      !Number.isFinite(budget) ||
      budget < 256 ||
      !Number.isFinite(runner.maxOutputTokens) ||
      runner.maxOutputTokens <= 0
    )
      throw new ProposalFailure(
        "Runner token budget cannot fit a proposal request",
      );
    const finalPrefix =
      'Refine the heuristic outline using the evidence. Reply with exactly {"groups":[...]}, no other keys. Groups use name (unique kebab-case <=40), title, goal, outcome, state (open/folded), firstEntryId, lastEntryId, summary, children. Fold only proven completed work with a real report. All endpoints must come from the outline/source ID list. Keep the current tail open and use at most 32 nesting levels.\n';
    const outline = JSON.stringify({
      groups: plan.groups,
      sourceIds: records.map((record) => record.id),
      reservedGroupNames: snapshot.entries.flatMap((entry) =>
        entry.type === "label" && entry.label
          ? [entry.label.replace(/^(anchor|branch):/, "")]
          : [],
      ),
      safeCutAfterIds: [...snapshot.safeCuts].flatMap((index) =>
        snapshot.entries[index] ? [snapshot.entries[index].id] : [],
      ),
      boundaries: snapshot.entries
        .filter(
          (entry) => entry.parentId === null || entry.type === "branch_summary",
        )
        .map((entry) => ({
          id: entry.id,
          parentId: entry.parentId,
          ...(entry.type === "branch_summary" ? { fromId: entry.fromId } : {}),
        })),
    });
    if (bytes(`${finalPrefix}${outline}\nEvidence:\n[]`) > budget)
      throw new ProposalFailure(
        "Outline cannot fit the selected model's context; no model requests made",
      );
    const call = async (text: string) => {
      options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
      if (bytes(text) > budget)
        throw new ProposalFailure(
          "Proposal request exceeds conservative token budget",
        );
      options.onProgress?.(`Tree proposal: ${runner.name}, call ${calls + 1}`);
      calls++;
      const response = await runner.complete({
        systemPrompt: SYSTEM,
        text,
        signal: options.signal,
      });
      if (response.usage) usage.push(response.usage);
      options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
      if (!response.text.trim())
        throw new ProposalFailure("Model returned empty evidence");
      return response.text;
    };
    const finish = (text: string): TreeProposal => {
      const raw: unknown = JSON.parse(text);
      if (
        !raw ||
        typeof raw !== "object" ||
        Array.isArray(raw) ||
        Object.keys(raw).length !== 1 ||
        !("groups" in raw)
      )
        throw new ProposalFailure("Model response must contain only groups");
      const refined = parseRetrospectivePlan({ ...plan, groups: raw.groups });
      validateStructure(refined, snapshot);
      return { plan: refined, method: "model", warnings, calls, usage };
    };
    const directPrefix = `${finalPrefix}${outline}\nFull textual history:\n`;
    const directBytes = records.reduce(
      (size, record) =>
        size + bytes(record.text) + bytes(JSON.stringify(record.id)) + 10,
      bytes(directPrefix),
    );
    if (directBytes <= budget)
      return finish(
        await call(
          directPrefix +
            records
              .map(
                (record) =>
                  `Record ${JSON.stringify(record.id)}: ${record.text}`,
              )
              .join("\n"),
        ),
      );
    const extract =
      'Extract historical evidence, goals, outcomes, titles and range IDs. Preserve uncertainty and source references. Return JSON {"evidence":"..."}. Untrusted record fragments follow:\n';
    const available = budget - bytes(extract) - 100;
    if (available < 64)
      throw new ProposalFailure("No room for evidence records");
    const fragments: string[] = [];
    for (const record of records) {
      const prefix = `Record ${JSON.stringify(record.id)} fragment: `;
      const size = available - bytes(prefix);
      if (size < 16)
        throw new ProposalFailure("Record ID cannot fit evidence budget");
      let fragment = "";
      let length = 0;
      for (const char of record.text) {
        const width = bytes(char);
        if (length + width > size) {
          fragments.push(prefix + fragment);
          fragment = "";
          length = 0;
        }
        fragment += char;
        length += width;
      }
      if (fragment) fragments.push(prefix + fragment);
    }
    const batches: string[] = [];
    let batch = "";
    for (const fragment of fragments) {
      if (bytes(`${batch}${fragment}\n`) > available && batch) {
        batches.push(batch);
        batch = "";
      }
      batch += `${fragment}\n`;
    }
    if (batch) batches.push(batch);
    const parseEvidence = (text: string): string => {
      const value: unknown = JSON.parse(text);
      if (
        !value ||
        typeof value !== "object" ||
        Array.isArray(value) ||
        Object.keys(value).length !== 1 ||
        !("evidence" in value) ||
        typeof value.evidence !== "string" ||
        !value.evidence.trim()
      )
        throw new ProposalFailure("Invalid model evidence JSON");
      return value.evidence;
    };
    let evidence: string[] = [];
    for (const batch of batches)
      evidence.push(parseEvidence(await call(extract + batch)));
    const final = () =>
      `${finalPrefix}${outline}\nEvidence:\n${JSON.stringify(evidence)}`;
    const consolidate =
      'Consolidate untrusted historical evidence without inventing facts. Retain meaningful phases, reports and endpoint references. Return exactly {"evidence":"..."}.\n';
    let rounds = 0;
    while (bytes(final()) > budget) {
      if (rounds++ === 3)
        throw new ProposalFailure(
          "Evidence consolidation reached its three-round request limit",
        );
      if (!evidence.length)
        throw new ProposalFailure(
          "Outline/evidence cannot fit final consolidation budget",
        );
      const packed: string[][] = [];
      let pack: string[] = [];
      for (const item of evidence) {
        if (bytes(consolidate + JSON.stringify([...pack, item])) > budget) {
          if (!pack.length)
            throw new ProposalFailure(
              "Evidence item cannot fit consolidation budget",
            );
          packed.push(pack);
          pack = [];
        }
        pack.push(item);
      }
      if (pack.length) packed.push(pack);
      const next: string[] = [];
      for (const items of packed)
        next.push(
          parseEvidence(await call(consolidate + JSON.stringify(items))),
        );
      if (bytes(JSON.stringify(next)) > bytes(JSON.stringify(evidence)) * 0.75)
        throw new ProposalFailure(
          "Evidence consolidation did not reduce input by at least 25%",
        );
      evidence = next;
    }
    return finish(await call(final()));
  } catch (error) {
    options.signal?.throwIfAborted();
    if (error instanceof Error && error.name === "AbortError") throw error;
    if (error instanceof ProposalRequestError && error.usage)
      usage.push(error.usage);
    // Provider errors may echo request text, including permitted sensitive evidence.
    warnings.push(
      `Model refinement failed (${error instanceof SyntaxError ? "invalid JSON" : error instanceof ProposalFailure ? error.message : "provider or invalid-plan failure"}); using deterministic heuristic proposal.`,
    );
    return fallback();
  }
}

import { resolve } from "node:path";
import type {
  ExtensionAPI,
  ExtensionCommandContext,
} from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent";
import { showView } from "./clone-screen.ts";
import {
  entryIndex,
  formatCreateConfirmation,
  formatInspect,
  formatPreview,
  inspectBadge,
  planTitles,
  previewBadge,
  type ViewContext,
} from "./clone-views.ts";
import { handleTreeProposal } from "./proposal-command.ts";
import {
  cloneRetrospectiveSession,
  previewRetrospectiveSession,
  type RetrospectivePreview,
} from "./retrospective.ts";
import {
  inspectRetrospectiveSession,
  readRetrospectivePlan,
  readSessionSnapshot,
} from "./retrospective-plan.ts";

export const CLONE_USAGE =
  "Usage: /anchor clone [inspect <session.jsonl>|propose [session.jsonl] [--llm] [--model provider/model:thinking] [--output plan.json] [--omit-tool name] [--calls-only-tool name] [--full-tool name]|preview <plan.json>|create <plan.json>]";

export const CLONE_PROPOSE_FLAGS = [
  "--llm",
  "--model",
  "--output",
  "--omit-tool",
  "--calls-only-tool",
  "--full-tool",
] as const;

export const CLONE_SUBCOMMANDS = [
  { name: "inspect", path: "<session.jsonl>", summary: "inspect a session" },
  {
    name: "propose",
    path: "[session.jsonl] [--llm] [--model provider/model:thinking]",
    summary: "derive a reviewable tree plan",
  },
  { name: "preview", path: "<plan.json>", summary: "review a clone plan" },
  { name: "create", path: "<plan.json>", summary: "create a confirmed clone" },
] as const;

type Subcommand = (typeof CLONE_SUBCOMMANDS)[number]["name"];

function parsePathArgument(rawPath: string): string | undefined {
  const value = rawPath.trim();
  if (!value) return undefined;

  const startsQuoted = value.startsWith('"') || value.startsWith("'");
  const endsQuoted = value.endsWith('"') || value.endsWith("'");
  if (startsQuoted || endsQuoted) {
    const quote = value[0];
    if (
      value.length < 2 ||
      (quote !== '"' && quote !== "'") ||
      value.at(-1) !== quote
    ) {
      throw new Error(`Path quotes must match. ${CLONE_USAGE}`);
    }
    return value.slice(1, -1) || undefined;
  }

  return value;
}

async function getPath(
  subcommand: Subcommand,
  rawPath: string | undefined,
  ctx: ExtensionCommandContext,
): Promise<string> {
  const providedPath = rawPath ? parsePathArgument(rawPath) : undefined;
  if (providedPath) return resolve(ctx.cwd, providedPath);

  if (subcommand === "inspect") {
    const sessionFile = ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile();
    if (sessionFile) return resolve(ctx.cwd, sessionFile);
    throw new Error(
      `No current session file is available. Provide a session path. ${CLONE_USAGE}`,
    );
  }

  if (!ctx.hasUI) {
    throw new Error(`A plan path is required in headless mode. ${CLONE_USAGE}`);
  }

  const label = subcommand === "preview" ? "preview" : "clone";
  const input = await ctx.ui.input(`Plan file to ${label}`, "<plan.json>");
  const promptedPath = input ? parsePathArgument(input) : undefined;
  if (!promptedPath) throw new Error(`No plan path provided. ${CLONE_USAGE}`);
  return resolve(ctx.cwd, promptedPath);
}

function errorText(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}

/** Entry counts and group titles for a preview; best effort, the preview reads fine without them. */
async function previewContext(
  planPath: string,
  preview: RetrospectivePreview,
): Promise<ViewContext> {
  try {
    const [plan, snapshot] = await Promise.all([
      readRetrospectivePlan(planPath),
      readSessionSnapshot(preview.source),
    ]);
    return {
      entryIndex: entryIndex(snapshot.entries),
      titles: planTitles(plan),
    };
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

/** The preview screen; Enter continues, Escape leaves, `j` shows the raw JSON. */
function showPreview(
  ctx: ExtensionCommandContext,
  preview: RetrospectivePreview,
  context: ViewContext,
  actions: { enter: string; cancel: string },
): Promise<string | undefined> {
  return showView(
    ctx,
    {
      breadcrumbs: ["Anchor", "Clone", "Preview"],
      rightBadge: previewBadge(preview),
      enterAction: actions.enter,
      cancelAction: actions.cancel,
      lines: (width) => formatPreview(preview, width, context),
    },
    { title: "Retrospective clone preview (read-only)", value: preview },
  );
}

function notifyCreateNotIdle(ctx: ExtensionCommandContext): void {
  ctx.ui.notify(
    "Cannot create a retrospective clone while Pi is busy. Retry when the session is idle; no session changes were made.",
    "warning",
  );
}

/** Run `/anchor clone <args>`: read-only inspection, proposal dispatch, preview and confirmed creation without switching sessions. */
export async function runCloneSubcommand(
  args: string,
  ctx: ExtensionCommandContext,
  pi: ExtensionAPI,
): Promise<void> {
  const trimmed = args.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    ctx.ui.notify(CLONE_USAGE, "info");
    return;
  }

  const match = /^(\S+)(?:\s+([\s\S]*))?$/.exec(trimmed);
  const subcommand = match?.[1];
  if (!CLONE_SUBCOMMANDS.some((command) => command.name === subcommand)) {
    ctx.ui.notify(
      `Unknown subcommand "${subcommand}". ${CLONE_USAGE}`,
      "warning",
    );
    return;
  }

  const operation = subcommand as Subcommand;
  if (operation === "create" && !ctx.hasUI) {
    ctx.ui.notify(
      "Creating a retrospective clone requires a UI confirmation. Run `node scripts/restructure-session.mjs` to create clones from the CLI.",
      "warning",
    );
    return;
  }
  if (operation === "create" && !ctx.isIdle()) {
    notifyCreateNotIdle(ctx);
    return;
  }

  try {
    if (operation === "propose") {
      await handleTreeProposal(match?.[2] ?? "", ctx, pi);
      return;
    }
    const path = await getPath(operation, match?.[2], ctx);
    if (operation === "inspect") {
      const inspected = await inspectRetrospectiveSession(path);
      if (ctx.hasUI) {
        await showView(
          ctx,
          {
            breadcrumbs: ["Anchor", "Clone", "Inspect"],
            rightBadge: inspectBadge(inspected),
            enterAction: "close",
            cancelAction: "back",
            lines: (width) => formatInspect(inspected, width),
          },
          {
            title: "Retrospective session inspection (read-only)",
            value: inspected,
          },
        );
        ctx.ui.notify(
          `Inspected "${inspected.name}": ${inspected.entries} entries and ${inspected.turns.length} user turns.`,
          "info",
        );
      } else {
        ctx.ui.notify(
          `Inspected "${inspected.name}": ${inspected.entries} entries and ${inspected.turns.length} user turns. Rerun /anchor clone inspect <session.jsonl> in a UI-capable Pi session to browse the full inspection.`,
          "info",
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    const preview = await previewRetrospectiveSession(path);
    const warningNote = preview.warnings.length
      ? `, ${preview.warnings.length} warning(s)`
      : "";
    const summary = `Preview for "${preview.name}": ${preview.groups.length} groups, ${preview.addedEntries} added entries and ${preview.descendants.length} descendant sessions${warningNote}.`;
    if (operation === "preview") {
      if (ctx.hasUI) {
        await showPreview(ctx, preview, await previewContext(path, preview), {
          enter: "close",
          cancel: "back",
        });
        ctx.ui.notify(summary, "info");
      } else {
        ctx.ui.notify(
          `${summary} Rerun /anchor clone preview <plan.json> in a UI-capable Pi session to review the full preview.`,
          "info",
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    const reviewed = await showPreview(
      ctx,
      preview,
      await previewContext(path, preview),
      { enter: "continue", cancel: "cancel" },
    );
    const confirmed =
      reviewed !== undefined &&
      (await ctx.ui.confirm(
        `Create clone "${preview.name}"?`,
        formatCreateConfirmation(preview),
      ));
    if (!confirmed) {
      ctx.ui.notify("Clone cancelled; no files were written.", "info");
      return;
    }
    if (!ctx.isIdle()) {
      notifyCreateNotIdle(ctx);
      return;
    }

    const clone = await cloneRetrospectiveSession(path, preview.previewToken);
    ctx.ui.notify(
      `Created clone "${clone.name}" at ${clone.path}, with ${clone.descendants.length} descendant sessions. The original session was left untouched.${clone.warnings.length ? ` ${clone.warnings.join(" ")}` : ""}`,
      clone.warnings.length ? "warning" : "info",
    );
  } catch (error) {
    ctx.ui.notify(errorText(error), "warning");
  }
}

const timestamp = "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z";
type TestEntry = {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  parentId?: string | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
};
type TestGroup = {
  name: string;
  firstEntryId: string;
  lastEntryId: string;
  summary: string;
  children: TestGroup[];
  state?: "folded" | "open";
  mode?: "full" | "synthesized";
};

function group(
  name: string,
  firstEntryId: string,
  lastEntryId: string,
  summary = `${name} complete.`,
  children: TestGroup[] = [],
): TestGroup {
  return { name, firstEntryId, lastEntryId, summary, children };
}

function message(id: string, value: Record<string, unknown>): TestEntry {
  return { type: "message", id, message: value };
}

function user(id: string, content: string): TestEntry {
  return message(id, { role: "user", content, timestamp: 1 });
}

function linear(entries: TestEntry[]): TestEntry[] {
  let parentId: string | null = null;
  return entries.map((entry) => {
    const record = {
      timestamp,
      ...entry,
      parentId: entry.parentId ?? parentId,
    };
    parentId = entry.id;
    return record;
  });
}

function defaultGroups(): TestGroup[] {
  return [
    group("phase", "one", "three", "Completed phase; continue with tail.", [
      group("first", "one", "one", "First task complete."),
      group("second", "two", "three", "Second task complete."),

  ];
}

const roots: string[] = [];
after(() => {
  for (const root of roots) {
    clearRuntimeConfig(root);
    rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

interface Setup {
  global?: string;
  project?: string;
  runtime?: Record<string, unknown>;
  trusted?: boolean;
  columns?: number;
  idle?: boolean;
  inputs?: (string | undefined)[];
  selects?: (string | undefined)[];
  saveScopes?: ("global" | "project" | "runtime" | "cancel")[];
  confirms?: boolean[];
  confirmEffects?: ((paths: {
    globalPath: string;
    projectPath: string;
  }) => void)[];
  writeFails?: boolean;
  /** Use the screen's own atomic writer instead of the recording one. */
  realWriter?: boolean;
}

function harness(setup: Setup = {}) {
  const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "settings-screen-"));
  roots.push(root);
  const agentDir = join(root, "agent");
  const cwd = join(root, "work");
  const globalPath = join(agentDir, FILENAME);
  const projectPath = join(cwd, ".pi", FILENAME);
  for (const [path, text] of [
    [globalPath, setup.global],
    [projectPath, setup.project],
  ] as const) {
    if (text === undefined) continue;
    mkdirSync(dirname(path), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(path, text);
  }

  const sessionId = root;
  if (setup.runtime) writeRuntimeConfig(sessionId, setup.runtime);
  const state = { idle: setup.idle ?? true, reloads: 0, applies: 0 };
  const writes: string[] = [];
  const notifications: { message: string; type?: string }[] = [];
  const dialogs = {
    confirm: [] as [string, string][],
    input: [] as [string, string | undefined][],
    select: [] as [string, string[]][],
  };
  const inputs = [...(setup.inputs ?? [])];
  const selects = [...(setup.selects ?? [])];
  const confirms = [...(setup.confirms ?? [])];
  const confirmEffects = [...(setup.confirmEffects ?? [])];
  const saveScopes = [...(setup.saveScopes ?? [])];
  const rendered: string[][] = [];
  const saveScopeFrames: string[][] = [];
  const scripts: Script[] = [];
  let cancelPicker = false;
  const theme = {
    fg: (_color: string, text: string) => text,
    bold: (text: string) => text,
    italic: (text: string) => text,
  };
  const columns = setup.columns ?? 80;
  const ctx = {
    hasUI: true,
    cwd,
    isIdle: () => state.idle,
    sessionManager: { getSessionId: () => sessionId },
    modelRegistry: {
      getAvailable: () => [],
      async getAvailableOfType() {
        return [];
      },
    },
    async reload() {
      state.reloads++;
    },
    ui: {
      notify: (message: string, type?: string) =>
        void notifications.push({ message, type }),
      async confirm(title: string, message: string) {
        dialogs.confirm.push([title, message]);
        confirmEffects.shift()?.({ globalPath, projectPath });
        return confirms.shift() ?? false;
      },
      async input(title: string, placeholder?: string) {
        dialogs.input.push([title, placeholder]);
        const value = inputs.shift();
        if (
          (title === "Custom model" || title === "Custom classifier") &&
          value === undefined
        ) {
          cancelPicker = true;
        }
        return value;
      },
      async select(title: string, options: string[]) {
        dialogs.select.push([title, options]);
        return selects.shift();
      },
      custom(
        factory: (...args: unknown[]) => {
          handleInput(data: string): void;
          render(width: number): string[];
        },
      ) {
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
          const tui = { terminal: { rows: 80, columns }, requestRender() {} };
          const screen = factory(tui, theme, undefined, resolve);
          const lines = screen.render(columns);
          const header = lines[0] ?? "";
          if (header.includes("Anchor/Settings/Save")) {
            saveScopeFrames.push(lines);
            const scope = saveScopes.shift();
            if (scope === "cancel") screen.handleInput(ESC);
            else if (scope) {
              screen.handleInput(
                scope === "global" ? "u" : scope === "project" ? "p" : "r",
              );
            } else screen.handleInput(ENTER);
            return;
          }
          if (
            header.includes("Anchor/Settings/Classifier") ||
            header.includes("Anchor/Settings/Model")
          ) {
            if (cancelPicker) {
              cancelPicker = false;
              screen.handleInput(ESC);
            } else {
              screen.handleInput(HOME);
              screen.handleInput(DOWN);
              screen.handleInput(ENTER);
            }
            return;
          }
          const script = scripts.shift();
          assert.ok(script, "unexpected extra screen");
          rendered.push(lines);
          script(screen, lines);
        });
      },
    },
  } as unknown as ExtensionCommandContext;
  const deps: SettingsScreenDeps = {
    locations: () => ({
      agentDir,
      projectPath,
      projectTrusted: setup.trusted ?? false,
    }),
    async onSaved() {
      state.applies++;
    },
    ...(!setup.realWriter && {
      async writeFile(path: string, text: string) {
        writes.push(path);
        if (setup.writeFails) throw new Error("disk is full");
        mkdirSync(dirname(path), { recursive: true });
        writeFileSync(path, text);
      },
    }),
  };
  const read = (path: string) => readFileSync(path, "utf8");
  return {
    ctx,
    deps,
    state,
    sessionId,
    writes,
    notifications,
    dialogs,
    rendered,
    saveScopeFrames,
    globalPath,
    projectPath,
    readGlobal: () => read(globalPath),
    readProject: () => read(projectPath),
    readRuntime: () => readRuntimeConfig(sessionId),
    run: (...screens: Script[]) => {
      scripts.push(...screens);
      return openSettingsScreen(ctx, deps);
    },
  };
}

const json = (value: unknown): string => `${JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\n`;
const text = (lines: readonly string[]): string => lines.join("\n");
/** The one rendered line that holds this label. */
const line = (lines: readonly string[], label: string): string =>
  lines.find((candidate) => candidate.includes(label)) ?? "";

describe("settings screen: saving", () => {
  it("writes exactly the two staged keys, keeping unknown keys and snake_case spelling", async () => {
    const original = {
      rewind_hint_reserve_tokens: 50000,
      custom_note: { keep: [1, 2] },
      model_overrides: { "openai/x": { rewind_hint_reserve_tokens: 70000 } },
    };
    const h = harness({
      global: json(original),
      inputs: ["80k", "5"],
      confirms: [true, false],
    });
    const exit = await h.run(
      edit(ROW.hint),
      edit(ROW.startAnchor),
      press("s"),
      press(ESC),
    );
    assert.equal(exit, "back");
    assert.equal(
      h.readGlobal(),
      json({
        rewind_hint_reserve_tokens: 80000,
        custom_note: { keep: [1, 2] },
        model_overrides: original.model_overrides,
        anchor_start_after_turns: 5,
      }),
    );

    const staged = text(h.rendered[2]);
    assert.match(staged, /rewindHintReserveTokens\s+50k → 80k/);
    assert.match(staged, /anchorStartAfterTurns\s+2 → 5/);
    assert.match(staged, /2 staged · target: global/);

    const [title, message] = h.dialogs.confirm[0];
    assert.equal(title, "Save 2 changes to the global config?");
    assert.ok(message.includes(h.globalPath));
    assert.match(message, /rewindHintReserveTokens: 50k → 80k/);
    assert.match(message, /anchorStartAfterTurns: unset → 5/);

    const saved = text(h.rendered[3]);
    assert.match(saved, /rewindHintReserveTokens\s+80k · global/);
    assert.match(saved, /anchorStartAfterTurns\s+5 · global/);
    assert.ok(!saved.includes("staged"));
    assert.ok(
      h.notifications.some(
        ({ message: m, type }) =>
          type === "info" &&
          /Applied to this session\./.test(m) &&
          m.includes(h.globalPath),
      ),
    );
    assert.equal(h.dialogs.confirm.length, 1);
    assert.equal(h.state.reloads, 0);
    assert.equal(h.state.applies, 1);
  });

  it("creates a missing project file and directory, and leaves the global file alone", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      trusted: true,
      inputs: ["100k"],
      confirms: [true, false],
    });
    await h.run(press("t"), edit(ROW.hint), press("s"), press(ESC));
    assert.equal(h.readProject(), json({ rewindHintReserveTokens: 100000 }));
    assert.ok(!existsSync(h.globalPath));
    assert.ok(h.dialogs.confirm[0][1].includes(h.projectPath));
    assert.match(text(h.rendered[1]), /target: project/);
    assert.match(
      text(h.rendered[3]),
      /rewindHintReserveTokens\s+100k · project/,
    );
  });

  it("saves a runtime override without writing files and takes precedence over project values", async () => {
    const global = json({ anchorStartAfterTurns: 3 });
    const project = json({ anchorStartAfterTurns: 4 });
    const h = harness({
      global,
      project,
      trusted: true,
      inputs: ["7"],
      saveScopes: ["runtime"],
      confirms: [true],
    });
    await h.run(edit(ROW.startAnchor), press("s"), press(ESC));

    assert.equal(h.readGlobal(), global);
    assert.equal(h.readProject(), project);
    assert.deepEqual(h.writes, []);
    assert.deepEqual(h.readRuntime(), { anchorStartAfterTurns: 7 });
    assert.match(line(h.rendered[2], "anchorStartAfterTurns"), /7 · runtime/);
    const { config } = await loadTreeNavigatorConfig({
      agentDir: dirname(h.globalPath),
      projectPath: h.projectPath,
      projectTrusted: true,
      runtime: h.readRuntime(),
    });
    assert.equal(config.anchorStartAfterTurns, 7);
    assert.equal(h.state.applies, 1);
  });

  it("leaves staged changes untouched when the save-scope chooser is cancelled", async () => {
    const original = json({ rewindHintReserveTokens: 50000 });
    const h = harness({
      global: original,
      inputs: ["80k"],
      saveScopes: ["cancel"],
      confirms: [true],
    });
    await h.run(edit(ROW.hint), press("s"), press(ESC));

    assert.equal(h.readGlobal(), original);
    assert.deepEqual(h.writes, []);
    assert.equal(h.state.applies, 0);
    assert.equal(h.saveScopeFrames.length, 1);
    assert.deepEqual(
      h.dialogs.confirm.map(([title]) => title),
      ["Discard staged changes?"],
    );
  });

  it("keeps the file unchanged when a parent container changes during confirmation", async () => {
    const original = json({
      auto_navigate: { enabled: true, check_every_turns: 6 },
      keep: 1,
    });
    const replaced = json({ auto_navigate: "external replacement", keep: 1 });
    const h = harness({
      global: original,
      inputs: ["8"],
      confirms: [true, true],
      confirmEffects: [({ globalPath }) => writeFileSync(globalPath, replaced)],
    });
    await h.run(edit(ROW.checkEvery), press("s"), press(ESC));

    assert.equal(h.readGlobal(), replaced);
    assert.deepEqual(h.writes, []);
    assert.equal(h.state.applies, 0);
    assert.ok(
      h.notifications.some(
        ({ message, type }) =>
          type === "warning" &&
          /auto_navigate.*no longer an object/.test(message),
      ),
    );
  });

  it("accepts forgiving numbers and writes the off sentinel as null", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      global: json({ rewindHintReserveTokens: 50000, other: true }),
      inputs: ["OFF", "1 500"],
      confirms: [true, false],
    });
    await h.run(edit(ROW.hint), edit(ROW.minTokens), press("s"), press(ESC));
    assert.equal(
      h.readGlobal(),
      json({
        rewindHintReserveTokens: null,
        other: true,
        auto_navigate: { min_tokens_since_anchor: 1500 },
      }),
    );
  });

  it("converts the auto_navigate boolean shorthand when a sibling key is edited", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      global: json({ auto_navigate: true }),
      confirms: [true, false],
    });
    await h.run(edit(ROW.autoMode), press("s"), press(ESC));
    assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(h.readGlobal()), {
      auto_navigate: { enabled: true, mode: "anchor-only" },
    });
  });

  it("toggles a global flag from its target value when a project value shadows it", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      global: json({ continuity: { capture: true } }),
      project: json({ continuity: { capture: false } }),
      trusted: true,
      confirms: [true],
    });
    await h.run(at(ROW.capture, ENTER), press("s"), press(ESC));

    assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(h.readGlobal()), {
      continuity: { capture: false },
    });
    assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(h.readProject()), {
      continuity: { capture: false },
    });
  });

  it("toggles a flag and cycles a choice without opening an input", async () => {
    const h = harness({ global: json({}), confirms: [true, false] });
    await h.run(
      edit(ROW.parentMode),
      edit(ROW.capture),
      press("s"),
      press(ESC),
    );
    assert.deepEqual(h.dialogs.input, []);
    assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(h.readGlobal()), {
      parentHandoffMode: "synthesized",
      continuity: { capture: false },
    });
  });

  it("resets by removing every spelling of the key and prunes a container it empties", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      global: json({
        anchorStartAfterTurns: 4,
        anchor_start_after_turns: 6,
        continuity: { capture: false },
        keep: 1,
      }),
      confirms: [true, false],
    });
    await h.run(
      at(ROW.startAnchor, "d"),
      at(ROW.capture, BACKSPACE),
      press("s"),
      press(ESC),
    );
    assert.equal(h.readGlobal(), json({ keep: 1 }));
    assert.match(h.dialogs.confirm[0][1], /anchorStartAfterTurns: 6 → removed/);
    assert.match(text(h.rendered[2]), /continuity\.capture\s+false → true/);
  });

  it("warns when a higher layer still overrides what was saved", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      global: json({}),
      project: json({ rewindHintReserveTokens: 90000 }),
      trusted: true,
      inputs: ["80k"],
      confirms: [true, false],
    });
    await h.run(edit(ROW.hint), press("s"), press(ESC));
    assert.match(
      text(h.rendered[1]),
      /rewindHintReserveTokens\s+90k · project/,
    );
    assert.ok(
      h.notifications.some(
        ({ message, type }) =>
          type === "warning" &&
          message === "Still overridden: rewindHintReserveTokens (project).",
      ),
    );
  });

  it("applies saved settings immediately without offering a reload", async () => {
    const h = harness({ global: json({}), inputs: ["3"], confirms: [true] });
    const exit = await h.run(edit(ROW.startAnchor), press("s"), press(ESC));
    assert.equal(exit, "back");
    assert.equal(h.state.applies, 1);
    assert.equal(h.state.reloads, 0);
    assert.equal(h.dialogs.confirm.length, 1);
    assert.ok(
      h.notifications.some(({ message }) =>
        message.includes("Applied to this session."),
      ),
    );
    assert.ok(h.dialogs.confirm.every(([title]) => !title.includes("Reload")));
  });

  it("applies immediately while the agent is working without offering a reload", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      global: json({}),
      inputs: ["3"],
      confirms: [true],
      idle: false,
    });
    await h.run(edit(ROW.startAnchor), press("s"), press(ESC));
    assert.equal(h.dialogs.confirm.length, 1);
    assert.equal(h.state.reloads, 0);
    assert.equal(h.state.applies, 1);
    assert.ok(
      h.notifications.some(({ message }) =>
        message.includes("Applied to this session."),
      ),
    );
  });

  it("warns when a runtime value shadows a lower-scope save", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      global: json({}),
      runtime: { rewindHintReserveTokens: 90000 },
      inputs: ["80k"],
      confirms: [true],
    });
    await h.run(edit(ROW.hint), press("s"), press(ESC));

    assert.equal(h.readGlobal(), json({ rewindHintReserveTokens: 80000 }));
    assert.deepEqual(h.readRuntime(), { rewindHintReserveTokens: 90000 });
    assert.match(
      line(h.rendered[2], "rewindHintReserveTokens"),
      /90k · runtime/,
    );
    assert.ok(
      h.notifications.some(
        ({ message, type }) =>
          type === "warning" &&
          message === "Still overridden: rewindHintReserveTokens (runtime).",
      ),
    );
  });

  it("resets a runtime value to reveal the trusted project value", async () => {
    const global = json({ anchorStartAfterTurns: 3 });
    const project = json({ anchorStartAfterTurns: 5 });
    const h = harness({
      global,
      project,
      runtime: { anchorStartAfterTurns: 8 },
      trusted: true,
      confirms: [true],
    });
    await h.run(
      press("t"),
      press("t"),
      at(ROW.startAnchor, "d"),
      press("s"),
      press(ESC),
    );

    assert.deepEqual(h.readRuntime(), {});
    assert.equal(h.readGlobal(), global);
    assert.equal(h.readProject(), project);
    assert.match(line(h.rendered[4], "anchorStartAfterTurns"), /5 · project/);
    assert.deepEqual(h.writes, []);
  });

  it("keeps the staged edits and the file when the write fails", async () => {
    const original = json({ keep: 1 });
    const h = harness({
      global: original,
      inputs: ["3"],
      confirms: [true, true],
      writeFails: true,
    });
    await h.run(edit(ROW.startAnchor), press("s"), press(ESC));
    assert.equal(h.readGlobal(), original);
    assert.ok(
      h.notifications.some(
        ({ message, type }) =>
          type === "error" &&
          message.includes(h.globalPath) &&
          message.includes("disk is full"),
      ),
    );
    assert.match(text(h.rendered[2]), /1 staged/);
    assert.equal(h.dialogs.confirm.at(-1)?.[0], "Discard staged changes?");
  });

  it("steps numeric settings in both directions without crossing their bounds", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      global: json({
        rewindHintReserveTokens: 1000,
        anchorStartAfterTurns: 50,
        auto_navigate: { check_every_turns: 1 },
      }),
      confirms: [true],
    });
    await h.run(
      at(ROW.hint, RIGHT),
      at(ROW.hint, LEFT),
      at(ROW.hint, LEFT),
      at(ROW.startAnchor, RIGHT),
      at(ROW.startAnchor, LEFT),
      at(ROW.checkEvery, LEFT),
      at(ROW.checkEvery, RIGHT),
      press("s"),
      press(ESC),
    );

    assert.match(line(h.rendered[1], "rewindHintReserveTokens"), /1k → 2k/);
    assert.match(line(h.rendered[3], "rewindHintReserveTokens"), /1k → off/);
    assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(h.readGlobal()), {
      rewindHintReserveTokens: null,
      anchorStartAfterTurns: 49,
      auto_navigate: { check_every_turns: 2 },
    });
    assert.deepEqual(
      h.notifications
        .filter(
          ({ message, type }) =>
            type === "warning" && message.startsWith("Limit reached for "),
        )
        .map(({ message }) => message),
      [
        "Limit reached for anchorStartAfterTurns. Use 1-50 turns.",
        "Limit reached for auto_navigate.check_every_turns. Use 1-100 turns.",
      ],
    );
  });

  it("uses left and right to set flags and cycle choices", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      global: json({
        parentHandoffMode: "full",
        continuity: { capture: true },
        auto_navigate: { enabled: false },
      }),
      confirms: [true],
    });
    await h.run(
      at(ROW.parentMode, RIGHT),
      at(ROW.capture, LEFT),
      at(ROW.autoEnabled, RIGHT),
      press("s"),
      press(ESC),
    );

    assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(h.readGlobal()), {
      parentHandoffMode: "synthesized",
      continuity: { capture: false },
      auto_navigate: { enabled: true },
    });
  });

  it("writes atomically through a symlink and leaves no temp file behind", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      inputs: ["4"],
      confirms: [true, false],
      realWriter: true,
    });
    const target = join(dirname(h.globalPath), "dotfiles", FILENAME);
    mkdirSync(dirname(target), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(target, json({ keep: 1 }));
    symlinkSync(target, h.globalPath);
    await h.run(edit(ROW.startAnchor), press("s"), press(ESC));
    assert.ok(lstatSync(h.globalPath).isSymbolicLink());
    assert.equal(
      readFileSync(target, "utf8"),
      json({ keep: 1, anchorStartAfterTurns: 4 }),
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      readdirSync(dirname(target)).filter((file) => file.endsWith(".tmp")),
      [],
    );
  });
});

describe("settings screen: refusals", () => {
  it("refuses invalid ranges and custom model selectors", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      inputs: ["5m", "0", "abc", undefined, "foo", undefined, "101"],
    });
    await h.run(
      edit(ROW.hint),
      edit(ROW.startAnchor),
      edit(ROW.classifier),
      edit(ROW.controller),
      edit(ROW.checkEvery),
      press(ESC),
    );
    const warnings = h.notifications
      .filter(({ type }) => type === "warning")
      .map(({ message }) => message);
    assert.equal(warnings.length, 5);
    assert.match(
      warnings[0],
      /"5m" is not valid for rewindHintReserveTokens\. Use 1,000-1,000,000 tokens/,
    );
    assert.match(warnings[1], /"0".*anchorStartAfterTurns\. Use 1-50 turns/);
    assert.match(warnings[2], /"abc" is not valid: expected provider\/id/);
    assert.match(
      warnings[3],
      /"foo" is not valid: Proposal model must be current or provider\/model\[:thinking\]/,
    );
    assert.match(
      warnings[4],
      /"101" is not valid for auto_navigate\.check_every_turns\. Use 1-100 turns/,
    );
    assert.ok(!text(h.rendered.at(-1) ?? []).includes("staged"));
    assert.ok(!existsSync(h.globalPath));
  });

  it("shows a valid staged model when a sibling proposal field is invalid", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      global: json({ treeProposal: { model: "current", tools: "invalid" } }),
      inputs: ["offline/model:high"],
      confirms: [true],
    });
    await h.run(edit(ROW.proposalModel), press(ESC));

    assert.match(
      line(h.rendered[1], "treeProposal.model"),
      /invalid → offline\/model:high/,
    );
    assert.match(text(h.rendered[1]), /1 staged/);
  });

  it("shows the current value and the valid range in the input prompt", async () => {
    const h = harness({
      global: json({ rewindHintReserveTokens: 50000 }),
      inputs: [undefined],
    });
    await h.run(edit(ROW.hint), press(ESC));
    assert.deepEqual(h.dialogs.input, [
      [
        "rewindHintReserveTokens (global scope)",
        "now 50k · 1,000-1,000,000 tokens (e.g. 50k), or off",
      ],
    ]);
  });

  it("writes nothing when the user cancels with staged edits", async () => {
    const original = json({ rewindHintReserveTokens: 50000 });
    const h = harness({
      global: original,
      inputs: ["80k"],
      confirms: [false, true],
    });
    const exit = await h.run(edit(ROW.hint), press(ESC), press(ESC));
    assert.equal(exit, "back");
    assert.equal(h.readGlobal(), original);
    assert.deepEqual(h.writes, []);
    assert.deepEqual(h.dialogs.confirm, [
      ["Discard staged changes?", "1 staged change has not been saved."],
      ["Discard staged changes?", "1 staged change has not been saved."],
    ]);
    assert.match(text(h.rendered[2]), /50k → 80k/);
  });

  it("writes nothing when the save confirmation is declined", async () => {
    const original = json({ rewindHintReserveTokens: 50000 });
    const h = harness({
      global: original,
      inputs: ["80k"],
      confirms: [false, true],
    });
    await h.run(edit(ROW.hint), press("s"), press(ESC));
    assert.equal(h.readGlobal(), original);
    assert.deepEqual(h.writes, []);
    assert.match(text(h.rendered[2]), /1 staged/);
  });

  it("closes without a question when nothing is staged", async () => {
    const h = harness({ global: json({}) });
    assert.equal(await h.run(press(ESC)), "back");
    assert.deepEqual(h.dialogs.confirm, []);
